Fixture Bakery

This page exists so the audit has a real HTTP server to talk to. It carries enough prose that the thin-entry guard stays quiet, a canonical that points at itself, one structured-data block, and a handful of internal links for the crawl to follow.

What we bake

Rye, sourdough, and a rotating loaf that depends entirely on what the miller sent us that week. Everything is made the same morning it is sold, which is the only interesting operational constraint in the whole business and the reason the opening hours are as strange as they are.

Where to find us

A fixture address in Vilnius, on a fixture street, behind a fixture door. See about for the version with a map in it.

Fixture Bakery. Not a real bakery.
